itemUsage.en: S.E.E.S. Leader Makoto Yuki came face-to-face with another self on a full moon night.
itemUsage.zh: S.E.E.S.队长结城理，于满月之夜得见另一个自己。

itemDesc.en: Pull the trigger, release the Persona from within the heart, and let blazing flames guide foes to annihilation.
itemDesc.zh: 扣动扳机，人格面具自内心解放，燎燃烈焰将敌人引入湮灭。

description.en: Passive: Summons <@ba.vup>Orpheus</> when switched to <Substitute> form; attacks deal <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Arts damage to enemies. If there are allied Operators with HP below <@ba.vup>50%</> within range, heals them for <@ba.vup>{attack@heal_scale:0%}</> of Makoto Yuki's ATK instead\nActive: Immediately switches to <Substitute> form
description.zh: 被动：<替身>状态召唤<@ba.vup>俄耳甫斯</>，攻击对敌人造成攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</>的法术伤害，范围内有生命值低于<@ba.vup>50%</>的友方干员时，改为对其治疗相当于结城理攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@heal_scale:0%}</>的生命值\n主动：立即切换为<替身>状态作战

description.en: Passive: Initially summons <@ba.vup>Thanatos</> when switched to <Substitute> form; Attack Speed <@ba.vup>+{talent@attack_speed}</>, attacks deal <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as <$ba.weaknessatk>Weakness damage</> to up to <@ba.vup>{attack@max_target}</> enemies. While <@ba.vup>Thanatos</> is present, activating the skill or taking fatal damage summons <@ba.vup>Orpheus</> instead: Block Count <@ba.vup>+{attack@block_cnt}</>, allied Operators within range gain <@ba.vup>{attack@prob:0%}</> Physical and Arts Dodge, and up to <@ba.vup>{attack@max_target_heal}</> allied Operators within range are healed for <@ba.vup>{attack@heal_scale:0%}</> of Makoto Yuki's ATK every second until the <Substitute> form ends\nActive: Immediately switches to <Substitute> form
description.zh: 被动：<替身>状态初始召唤<@ba.vup>塔纳托斯</>，攻击速度<@ba.vup>+{talent@attack_speed}</>，攻击对至多<@ba.vup>{attack@max_target}</>名敌人造成攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</>的<$ba.weaknessatk>弱点伤害</>，<@ba.vup>塔纳托斯</>在场时，开启技能或受到致命伤时改为召唤<@ba.vup>俄耳甫斯</>，阻挡数<@ba.vup>+{attack@block_cnt}</>，使范围内友方干员获得<@ba.vup>{attack@prob:0%}</>的物理与法术闪避并每秒治疗范围内最多<@ba.vup>{attack@max_target_heal}</>名友方干员相当于结城理攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@heal_scale:0%}</>的生命值，直到<替身>状态结束\n主动：立即切换为<替身>状态作战

description.en:
One afternoon, under the blazing sun, Giada pointed toward the warehouse ahead. Giulio and Makoto Yuki pulled up the roll-up door together with all their strength.
Inside, it was cool. Giada walked up to a row of storage shelves and said, "These were hers." Giada told Giulio to inspect everything on the nearby table, while Yuki stood beside Giulio, helping him pack the items he decided to keep into cardboard boxes.
"This is..." Giulio opened a storage box and marvelled, "What an old song."
He asked Giada, "Are these all tapes collected by Auntie? Did you listen to them when going through her effects?" Giada shook her head. "Not all of them... and not all of them were collections."
Giada sorted out a few plain-looking tapes and said, "These should be recordings she made herself. I mentioned to Yuki that I heard a song among her effects, and this is where it was." Yuki seemed a little perplexed, while Giulio asked curiously, "Which one? I want to hear it too."
After a brief hesitation, Giada picked out a tape, inserted it into the radio nearby, plugged it in, and pressed play.
The home-recorded cassette hissed with static. Unaccompanied, a slightly hoarse woman's voice sang a tender, affectionate melody, bringing Giulio close to tears. The afternoon sunlight poured into the warehouse, the dazzling white light rippling across the floor like water.
"...Candy, guns, and faith, I drink Laterano to the dregs." He quietly sang along to the final lines.
The music faded, and surprisingly, Yuki was the first to speak: "I remember now, what Miss Giada said back then... So, your insistence regarding the funeral, was it really about this song?"
Giada replied, "...Yeah. This tape was probably recorded not long ago... But basing the deceased's wishes on merely how I felt hearing a song was perhaps too presumptuous of me."
Yuki shook his head. "Music truly can tell us a lot of things."
"...Speaking of which, Yuki seems to listen to music quite often, doesn't he?" Giulio lowered his head to wipe his eyes, his usual smile returning.
"Well..." Yuki was caught off guard by the sudden shift of topic to himself, while Giada let out a quiet sigh of relief. Giulio asked again, "What kind of songs do you usually listen to, Yuki?"
"...I can let everyone hear them, if you'd like." Yuki turned on his portable player and showed it to them.
"Actually, does listening to the same song feel a bit like empathy?" Giulio rubbed his chin and mused aloud.
"Except for you, nobody here knows what empathy feels like..." Giada couldn't help saying.
"...I think I might understand," Yuki answered earnestly.
Suddenly, Giada remembered something. On that day, that very dusk, what she had felt. At the very end, she had indeed heard music—the sound of a cello, like starlight, like the evening glow.
"...Then perhaps, I've felt it too," Giada said.
"Right? Music is a feeling you can hear," Giulio smiled gently.
"There has always been a way to understand how others feel," Yuki looked at Giulio and said with conviction. "There are many things that can connect us all together."
"As long as moments like that have existed, they will never truly fade away," he said.
description.zh:
一个下午，太阳炽热地挂在天上，吉阿达指了指面前的仓库，裘里奥和结城理一起使劲拉起了卷帘门。
仓库里倒是阴凉，吉阿达走到某排储物架前，说：“这些是她的。”吉阿达让裘里奥把东西在旁边的桌子上都检视一遍，理站在裘里奥身旁，帮他把确认留下的物品放进纸箱。
“这是……”裘里奥打开一个储物盒，感叹道，“好老的歌啊。”
他问吉阿达：“这些都是姨妈收藏的磁带吗，你研究遗物的时候是不是听过？”吉阿达摇摇头：“没有听完全部……也不全都是收藏。”
吉阿达拣出几盘样子朴素的，说：“这些应该是她自己录的。我和结城提过，在遗物里听到了一首歌，就是在这里。”理有点疑惑，裘里奥则好奇地问：“哪一盘？我也想听。”
吉阿达犹豫了一下，拿出一盘磁带放进旁边的收音机，插上电，按下了播放键。
家庭录制的磁带响着沙沙声，没有伴奏，略微沙哑的女声唱着柔情又依恋的歌，裘里奥却渐渐想要落泪。下午的阳光照进了仓库里，耀眼的白光落在地上像水波。
“……糖与铳与信心，我将拉特兰一饮而尽。”他低声跟着唱完了最后几句。
音乐结束了，最先说话的竟然是理：“我想起来了，吉阿达小姐当时说的话……所以，你对葬礼的坚持，其实是与这首歌有关吗？”
吉阿达说：“……嗯。这盘磁带，应该就是不久前录的……不过，只是听到一首歌的心情，我把它当成逝者的意愿，还是太自以为是了。”
理摇了摇头：“音乐确实能告诉我们很多事。”
“……这样说来，理似乎经常在听音乐呢。”裘里奥低头抹了一下眼睛，又恢复了平时的笑容。
“还好……”话题突然转移到自己身上，理猝不及防，吉阿达却悄悄松了一口气。裘里奥又问：“理平时都听什么歌呢？”
“……这些，也可以给大家听。”理启动随身携带的播放器，给两人看了看。
“其实，听同一首歌是不是就有点像共感？”裘里奥摸摸自己的下巴，突然说。
“除了你这里谁也不知道共感是什么感觉吧……”吉阿达忍不住说。
“……我好像能明白。”理却认真地回答了。
吉阿达突然想起了一件事。在那一天，那一个傍晚，她曾体会过的。在那最后，她确实听到了音乐声，如星光、如晚霞一般的大提琴声。
“……那也许，我也感受过。”吉阿达说。
“是吧，音乐也是能听见的心情呢。”裘里奥温柔地笑着。
“能体会他人心情的办法，一直都是存在的。”理看向裘里奥，认真地说，“有很多东西都可以把我们连系在一起。”
“那样的时刻只要存在过，就不会消逝了。”他说。
